relationships.subject: ST-2530
relationships.evidence_quote: We describe a small molecule Nav1.7 inhibitor, ST-2530, that is an analog of the naturally occurring sodium channel blocker saxitoxin.

relationships.subject: ST-2530
relationships.evidence_quote: In the spared nerve injury model of neuropathic pain, ST-2530 transiently reversed mechanical allodynia.

relationships.subject: naloxone
relationships.evidence_quote: Naloxone had no effect on the increase in withdrawal latency to the thermal stimulus mediated by ST-2530

key_findings: ST-2530 is a saxitoxin-derived Nav1.7 inhibitor (Kd 25 nM human) with >500-fold isoform selectivity.
At 3 mg/kg it was analgesic across acute, postoperative and SNI models independent of mu-opioid receptors.
